(2) 'Detection-driven' should read 'non-division-driven' (detection, node count, gap and rescue), and x138's validator/PP-sweep cells add a further confound. (3) The correction only removes a false negative. It is NOT positive evidence for division ADD rungs such as R19-RC-A, which must stand on their own gate. IDEAS I-352 already calls V6 confounded, but round17 REPORT l.17, round18 slots_28sep and PC18-04 used it as a negative for division rungs, so the correction is needed. FEASIBILITY: documentation only. No runtime, no slot, no kernel, and no R1-R10 rule touched.
